rag.text:
Test: TC-1692 — Box module - Board - Reports - Displaying reports group by assignee
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-103 Box module - Board - Reports
Labels: can_be_automated, teamagile

Steps:
1. Navigate to Board module of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-1692 Box module - Board - Reports - Displaying reports group by assignee
   Expected: Board module is successfully loaded and displayed. PI1 and PI2 with tasks are visible.
2. Click on Reports icon from header and click on cog icon.
   Expected: Reports are loaded with the default view:
- Chart type: Pie
- Data source: Tasks
- Group by: Status
- Count: Tasks
3. Set Group by Assignee
   Expected: Reports are loaded with the view:
- Chart type: Pie
- Data source: Tasks
- Group by: Assignee
- Count: Tasks
4. Check Reports values for teamName in PI1
   Data: teamName: TC1692TeamA
   Expected: Values:
- 50% User TC1692A
- 50% User TC1692B
5. Click "Level down" button of subboxName
   Data: subboxName: PI1
   Expected: Iteration and Iteration1 are visible. Iteration box has a pie chart in TC1692TeamB.
6. Check Reports values for teamName in Iteration
   Data: teamName: TC1692TeamB
   Expected: Values:
- 25% User TC1692A
- 25% User TC1692B
- 25% User TC1692C
- 25% User TC1692D
